title: AI-Centric IT Governance Model (AI9GM), Draft for Review
description:
Draft for Review. Not accredited. No conformity assessment exists.

AI9GM v0.9, release 0.9.0. The AI-Centric IT Governance Model specification, edited and published by Florante Pascual (ORCID 0009-0007-7267-9031).

AI9GM is written, published and implemented by the same person. Florante Pascual is the specification's editor. He is its publisher. He is currently its only implementation partner.

This concentration is a limitation and it is recorded as one. The framework has had no independent review. Findings from implementations conducted by its author are a record of the framework being used, not independent validation of it, and they are published as such.

Independent stewardship is an intention on the roadmap. It is not a fact.

The known limitations register records what the framework has not established, including this concentration as KL-57. It is part of this record, at specifications/limitations-register.md.

Corrections are raised at ai9gm.com, from the page they concern. This archived copy does not depend on that site. The site carries the current text.
